item.title: Caker 1.0.3732
item.description:
Caker 1.0.3732

New version of Caker with improvements and bug fixes.

2026-10-17 (Git log summary - release)

  • fix: include vncURL and screenSize when rendering VM info
  • chore: move App Store build artifacts under appstore/build/
  • fix(caker): don't force-unwrap the selected network in HomeView's detail pane
  • fix: lower min requirements for Ubuntu 26.10 Server images
  • fix(ui): widen VM wizard sheet to fit content
  • fix(ui): add horizontal padding to sidebar status icon
  • fix(vm): always show Cancel button in wizard footer
  • fix(vm): Correctly apply display scaling to VNC render layer
  • refactor(vm): remove dedicated scaling logic for OCR rendering
  • fix(packer): ignore IP address detection for OpenSUSE builds
  • fix(vm): log provisioning task cancellation for easier debugging
  • fix(packer): handle opensuse installer mode selection screen in boot command
  • fix(vm): Only enable automatic display refit in normal mode
  • fix(grpc): append the image name fields instead of renumbering
  • fix(dhcp): allow missing hostname when parsing DHCP leases
  • fix(packer): replace coordinate click with keyboard shortcut in opensuse boot command
  • fix(vm): always fall back to ARP lookup regardless of network type
  • fix(ui): constrain provisioned VM preview to configured display aspect ratio
  • fix(packer): match SupportedPlatform against full image URL
  • fix(ui): tighten spacing and field widths across VM settings detail views
  • fix(ui): fix sheet sizing for editable list edit views

  • fix(ui): simplify sheet sync main thread dispatch
